add.title: LGBTQ rights in Nigeria (Wikipedia) - criminalisation layer incl. Katsina
add.summary: Wikipedia's 'LGBTQ rights in Nigeria' (fetched in full via MediaWiki API, cached research/fetched/815928c9a45eeba4.txt) documents the penalty structure relevant to any trans prisoner in Katsina: in the Shari'a-governed northern states punishments range from lashing/caning to capital punishment, and lesbianism (carnal acts or stimulation between women) is punishable by imprisonment or caning in most states with death penalties applied in Kano and Katsina. It also records the cross-dressing layer: men who dress or behave as women face prison or a fine, citing a 20 Jun 2025 Kano court sentence of a TikToker to one year in prison over a cross-dressing video. Placement axis: the article contains no statement on where trans prisoners are housed - no placement rule, no segregation or women's-wing policy, no Katsina prison-administration measure; it is a criminalisation/penalty record, not a housing record.
